macos_filevault_off.query: SELECT 'filevault_off' AS finding FROM disk_encryption WHERE encrypted = 0 AND name IN (SELECT device FROM mounts WHERE path = '/System/Volumes/Data');
macos_filevault_off.description: FileVault is off on the data volume.

macos_gatekeeper_off.query: SELECT 'gatekeeper_off' AS finding FROM gatekeeper WHERE assessments_enabled = 0;

macos_firewall_off.query: SELECT 'firewall_off' AS finding FROM alf WHERE global_state = 0;

windows_firewall_or_av_off.query: SELECT 'security_center_' || CASE WHEN firewall != 'Good' THEN 'firewall' ELSE 'antivirus' END || '_not_good' AS finding FROM windows_security_center WHERE firewall != 'Good' OR antivirus != 'Good';

old_os.query: SELECT name, version FROM os_version WHERE (platform = 'darwin' AND major < 14) OR (platform = 'windows' AND CAST(build AS INTEGER) < 19045);
old_os.description: macOS older than 14 or Windows older than 10 22H2.
